# Todaytec Group Europe

European coating and converting operations of the Todaytec Group.

Site: https://todaytecgroupeurope.com
Languages: English, Français, Deutsch, Español

## What we do
Todaytec Group Europe supplies thermal transfer ribbons (TTR) for industrial labelling, coding and print-and-apply. The group combines REGMA (France, coating since 1986), Calor (Germany, converting since 1991) and Thermal Transfer Solutions (UK 2006 and Netherlands 2016). Formed as Todaytec Group Europe in 2025.

## Products
- Advantage Range: nine compact grades covering ~95% of applications, 400+ stock sizes, next-day dispatch
- Flat head: TDW108 wax, TDW136 resin-enhanced wax, TDM200 wax resin, TDM242 high-performance wax resin, TDR345 premium resin
- Near edge: TDM665 wax resin, TDM680 high-speed wax resin, TDM680X longer rolls, TDR540 specialty resin
- Colour ribbons: 100+ colour qualities, made to order in five days
- Versawipes printer cleaning wipes

## Services
- Made-to-measure sizes, cores and winding
- Special development (unique inks, colours, two-colour and UV ribbons)
- Free samples and laboratory testing (UK and France); UK on-site engineer visits
- Free private-label box-end labels and datasheets (no MOQ)
- Ribbon Exchange (TRX): price support, testing, sale-or-return
